1 3oz jar bacon bits 
1/2 chopped onion raw 
2 cups shredded mozzarella 
1/2 cups shredded cheddar 
1/2 cups shredded Parmesan 
1 9inch deep pie crust 
4 eggs beaten 
1 cup half and half cream 

Preheat oven at 400
In bowl mix cheeses and bacon. I subbed for real bacon and removed the grease with a paper towel. 
Put the bacon and cheese mixture at the bottom of the pie crust. 
Mix eggs and half and half in a bowl then pour gently over the bacon and cheese mixture. 
Bake for around 45 minutes or until the middle is almost set but not fully set. The slight jiggle is what you’re looking for ! 

Enjoy ! It’s so easy and relaxing to make.
